spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:

  max(level_sub_pump_1_alarm__value) AS "Subm. pump 1",

  max(batt_comp_6_alarm__value) AS "Battery comp 6",
  max(frame_13_alarm__value) AS "Frame 13",
  max(frame_15_alarm__value) AS "Frame 15",
  max(frame_30_alarm__value) AS "Frame 30",
  max(frame_38_alarm__value) AS "Frame 38",
  max(frame_38_ps_alarm__value) AS "Frame 38 PS",
  max(frame_38_sb_alarm__value) AS "Frame 38 SB",
  max(frame_46_alarm__value) AS "Frame 46",
  max(frame_47_sb_alarm__value) AS "Frame 47 SB",
  max(frame_48_alarm__value) AS "Frame 48",

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/210000-bilge-fifi-general' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path

SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.level_sub_pump_1_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.level_sub_pump_2_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 3 THEN CASE l.level_sub_pump_3_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 4 THEN CASE l.batt_comp_5_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 5 THEN CASE l.batt_comp_6_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 6 THEN CASE l.frame_13_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 7 THEN CASE l.frame_15_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 8 THEN CASE l.frame_30_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 9 THEN CASE l.frame_38_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 10 THEN CASE l.frame_38_ps_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 11 THEN CASE l.frame_38_sb_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 12 THEN CASE l.frame_46_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 13 THEN CASE l.frame_47_sb_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 14 THEN CASE l.frame_48_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 15 THEN CASE l.frame_53_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 16 THEN CASE l.frame_68_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 17 THEN CASE l.water_separator_ppm_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Subm. pump 1', 'level_sub_pump1_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Subm. pump 2', 'level_sub_pump2_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),

  (7, 'Frame 15', 'frame15_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (8, 'Frame 30', 'frame30_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (9, 'Frame 38', 'frame38_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),

  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",

spec.title: Valve positions
spec.description: Per valve and time bucket: alarm (any alarm flag), opened, closed, or neither (travelling or no feedback).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001010' THEN 'Frame 48 (XV21001010)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001011_1' THEN 'Frame 30 (XV21001011_1)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001011_2' THEN 'Frame 53 (XV21001011_2)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001012_1' THEN 'Frame 38 (XV21001012_1)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001012_2' THEN 'Frame 46 (XV21001012_2)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001012_3' THEN 'Frame 68 (XV21001012_3)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001012_4' THEN 'Frame 48 (XV21001012_4)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001012_5' THEN 'Frame 15 (XV21001012_5)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001013_1' THEN 'Frame 13 (XV21001013_1)'
    WHEN topic LIKE '%xv21001013_2' THEN 'Frame 13 (XV21001013_2)'
    ELSE upper(split_part(topic, '/', 3)) END AS valve,
  max(CASE
      WHEN alarm__value OR multi_state_alarm__value THEN 3
      WHEN opened__value THEN 2
      WHEN closed__value THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END) AS state
FROM marpower__210000_bilge_fifi
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Valves
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Every valve published in the IO metadata is listed; its values are empty when it published nothing in the live window.

spec.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mqtt_topic AS topic FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic LIKE 'marpower/210000-bilge-fifi/%'
),
f AS (
  SELECT topic,
    last_value(alarm__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS alarm,
    last_value(close__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS close,
    last_value(closed__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS closed,
    last_value(hmi_cmd_close__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS hmi_cmd_close,
    last_value(hmi_cmd_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS hmi_cmd_open,
    last_value(hmi_control_available__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS hmi_control_available,
    last_value(open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS open,
    last_value(opened__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS opened,
    last_value(should_be_open__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS should_be_open,
    last_value(multi_state_alarm__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS multi_state_alarm,
    last_value(power_detected__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS power_detected,
    max(timestamp) AS ts
  FROM marpower__210000_bilge_fifi
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  GROUP BY topic
)
SELECT d.topic AS topic,
  f.alarm AS alarm,
  f.close AS close,
  f.closed AS closed,
  f.hmi_cmd_close AS hmi_cmd_close,
  f.hmi_cmd_open AS hmi_cmd_open,
  f.hmi_control_available AS hmi_control_available,
  f.open AS open,
  f.opened AS opened,
  f.should_be_open AS should_be_open,
  f.multi_state_alarm AS multi_state_alarm,
  f.power_detected AS power_detected,
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(f.ts) AS "Updated"
FROM d
LEFT JOIN f ON f.topic = d.topic
ORDER BY d.topic

spec.name: live_window
spec.description: How far back the Live tabs look for the latest message, independent of the time picker. The Live tables' no-data text ('No data in the last 5 minutes') repeats this value.
